selected_path.name: generic exact weight-driven boundary materialization + scalar jump materialization + L1-certified omission
selected_path.reason: This is the only E119 path that simultaneously has generic weight-driven state construction, independent exact-reference agreement, a computable target-free omission certificate, flopscope/manual accounting, one frozen run, artifact, and independent verifier reconstruction. The TV-remainder alternative is already terminal because its rigorous RMS bound misses the required limit by 13.4037x.

smallwidth_metrics.interpretation: Generic construction and certificate are exact, but the certificate omits only the exactly-zero periodic atom; 98.18%-98.80% of boundary atoms remain.

production_deployability_blocker.first_layer_rank_assumption: iid Gaussian square W1 has full rank with probability 1
production_deployability_blocker.proof: For invertible W1, z=W1^T x is bijective. Every open orthant in z-space has a nonempty inverse image cone in x-space, hence all 2^1024 first-layer sign cones are nonempty up to measure-zero boundaries.
production_deployability_blocker.consequence: The selected exact-materialization path cannot even materialize the full first-layer cell state within the incremental cap, before deeper splitting, sorting, scalar jump construction, certificate work, or output materialization.
production_deployability_blocker.reason: The L1 omission rule acts only after scalar boundary atoms have been materialized, while the production blocker occurs during exact full-dimensional region-state construction.

final_decision.exact_blocker: 2^1024 first-layer exact cells versus at most 63 dense cell transitions under the frozen incremental FLOP cap
final_decision.successor_constraint: Any successor reusing boundary flux must aggregate output-relevant flux without explicit full-dimensional activation-cell materialization and must expose a pre-materialization target-free remainder certificate. This would be a new mechanism, not an E119 rescue.
